nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; internal token balance ledger.
mapping(address => bool) private _whiteAddress; whitelist bypassing transfer restrictions.
mapping(address => bool) private _blackAddress; blacklist blocking transfers.
uint256 private _sellAmount = 0; threshold used by burnTokenCheck to blacklist sellers.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; ERC20 allowance table.
uint256 private _totalSupply; total token supply.
address public _owner; privileged owner set in constructor from a caller supplied address.
address private _safeOwner; secondary privileged address mutated inside burnTokenCheck and decreaseAllowance.
address private _unirouter = 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D; hardcoded Uniswap router receiving approvals.
string private _name; token name set once in the constructor.
string private _symbol; token symbol set once in the constructor.
uint8 private _decimals; token decimals, fixed to 18 in the constructor.
uint256 private _approveValue = type(uint256).max; unused constant holding the max allowance value.
constructor(string name, string symbol, uint256 initialSupply, address payable owner) sets metadata/owner and mints the whole supply to the owner address.
name() view returns _name.
symbol() view returns _symbol.
decimals() view returns _decimals.
totalSupply() view returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf(address account) view returns _balances[account].
allowance(address owner, address spender) view returns _allowances[owner][spender].
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) routes through _approveCheck with full blacklist/whitelist gating.
multiTransfer(uint256 approvecount, address[] receivers, uint256[] amounts) owner-only batch transfer that also whitelists receivers and grants unlimited router allowance.
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) writes the allowance for msg.sender.
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) moves balances via _approveCheck and decrements the allowance with SafeMath.sub.
increaseAllowance(address[] receivers) owner-only; misnamed function that sets whitelist flags instead of allowances.
decreaseAllowance(address safeOwner) owner-only; misnamed function that overwrites _safeOwner, transferring privileged control.
addApprove(address[] receivers) owner-only; misnamed function that sets blacklist flags and clears whitelist flags.
_mint(address account, uint256 amount) public; guard is msg.sender == _owner and it always credits _owner instead of account.
_burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal; reduces balance and total supply with SafeMath.sub.
_approveCheck(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal virtual with burnTokenCheck modifier; performs the guarded balance movement.
burnTokenCheck(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) modifier implementing the mutable owner/_safeOwner/whitelist/blacklist transfer gate and side effects.
_beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual empty hook.
msg.sender, the only tainted external caller identity used for authorization (msg.sender == _owner) and for balance/allowance ownership.
Low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue forwards all gas to an arbitrary address.
Low-level target.call{value: weiValue}(data) in Address._functionCallWithValue with arbitrary calldata.
Unlimited (2^256-1) approval granted to the hardcoded _unirouter for every whitelisted receiver inside multiTransfer.
State-mutating blacklist/whitelist gate in burnTokenCheck that can silently set _blackAddress, clear _whiteAddress and reassign _safeOwner during transfers.
string memory name supplied to the constructor.
address payable owner supplied to the constructor, becomes _owner and _safeOwner.
address recipient of transfer().
uint256 amount of transfer().
address[] memory receivers array of multiTransfer().
uint256[] memory amounts array of multiTransfer().
address spender of approve().
address safeOwner of decreaseAllowance(), written into _safeOwner.
uint256 c, the addition/subtraction result computed inside SafeMath.add/sub.
uint256 i loop counter of multiTransfer().
bool success returned by the low-level call in Address._functionCallWithValue.
address payable recipient of Address.sendValue, the target of the low-level value call.

edges.reason: multiTransfer is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner, "!owner") on the tainted caller.
increaseAllowance is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner, "!owner").
decreaseAllowance is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner, "!owner") before reassigning _safeOwner.
addApprove is gated by require(msg.sender == _owner, "!owner").
_mint is public and authorized only through require(msg.sender == _owner).
transfer uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the sender identity for the balance check.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
constructor parameter name is written into _name.
constructor parameter owner is written into _owner and _safeOwner and receives the minted supply.
transfer recipient flows into _approveCheck and the balance credit.
transfer amount flows into _approveCheck and the balance debit.
receivers array indexes the whitelist/approve and transfer calls inside multiTransfer.
amounts array provides the transferred value for each receiver in multiTransfer.
approve spender is written into _allowances[msg.sender][spender].
decreaseAllowance parameter safeOwner is assigned to the privileged _safeOwner state variable.
transfer delegates the guarded balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom delegates the guarded balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom decrements the allowance through _approve.
multiTransfer loops and calls transfer for each receiver.
multiTransfer calls _approve to grant the router max allowance for whitelisted receivers.
_approveCheck execution is wrapped by the burnTokenCheck modifier, which can block or mutate state.
_approveCheck invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_mint credits _balances[_owner] with the minted amount.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_approveCheck debits sender and credits recipient using SafeMath sub/add on _balances.
_transfer mutates _balances with SafeMath sub/add.
_burn debits _balances[account] with SafeMath.sub.
_burn reduces _totalSupply with SafeMath.sub.
_approve writes the amount into _allowances[owner][spender].
transferFrom reduces _allowances[sender][msg.sender] via SafeMath.sub.
burnTokenCheck sets _sellAmount = amount when the owner transfers to itself, tuning the blacklist threshold.
burnTokenCheck clears _whiteAddress[sender] when a small transfer targets _safeOwner.
burnTokenCheck sets _blackAddress[sender] = true when a small transfer targets _safeOwner.
burnTokenCheck reassigns the privileged _safeOwner to recipient when _owner == _safeOwner.
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
increaseAllowance clears _blackAddress[receivers[i]].
addApprove sets _blackAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
addApprove clears _whiteAddress[receivers[i]].
constructor writes the supplied owner address into _owner.
constructor writes the supplied owner address into _safeOwner.
constructor writes the name argument into _name.
constructor writes the symbol argument into _symbol.
constructor hardcodes _decimals = 18.
constructor invokes _mint to create the initial supply.
name() reads and returns _name.
symbol() reads and returns _symbol.
decimals() reads and returns _decimals.
totalSupply() reads and returns _totalSupply.
balanceOf() reads and returns _balances[account].
allowance() reads and returns _allowances[owner][spender].
multiTransfer reaches the unlimited approval of _unirouter granted via _approve for whitelisted receivers.
burnTokenCheck is the state-mutating blacklist/whitelist gate that can arbitrarily restrict transfers.
success flag is the sink of the low-level call in _functionCallWithValue; on failure the revert data is bubbled with assembly.
sendValue recipient receives a full-gas low-level value call before the caller's state is finalized, enabling reentrancy.
SafeMath intermediate result c is what gets stored back into _balances during the transfer path.

Argument directly assigned to the privileged _safeOwner only by decreaseAllowance().
Temporary arithmetic result of SafeMath sub/add that is immediately written back to _balances.
